Arrival (Advent (page 22)) This was a bit embarrassing. The two of them had performed a scene in front of Lin Chuchen before. At this time, even if Luo Heng wanted to save him, he did not dare to offend Chen Wuhai. When the league heard this, several clubs would not agree. Yi Yanshen retired like this. As for quitting Tianyu, Yanshen's character will never quit without reason. "Bao-zhao-po. Hahaha." Zhang Qi couldn't stand the funny feeling when he compared the Baizi in front of him with the Baozi in Stephen Chow's movie. Moreover, he was a big V account, and the comments he sent had a special display. When Shen Zhiyou saw him like this, he knew that he was so old. Except for the clothes issued by the army, no one in his family made special clothes for him. Although Ya Aili was a prince, his status was naturally lower than that of Han Bas in Karen's eyes. Khan Bas had saved Karen's life and gave him a Qi sword, which made him more popular in Kai. In his heart, he is as approachable and respectable as a teacher and a friend. "Shaolong, let's leave it like this for today. You and Fatty Wang go home first, I have some things to do." Zhang Shaofei said with a frown: I am twenty years younger than Lingxu, and ten years older than the current head of Wudang. He has hundreds of disciples in Wudang. The situation is getting bigger and bigger, but I am still alone, and I don't even know who to pass on my unique skills. If he hadn't slept next to her last night, Shen Zhiyou would have suspected that he couldn't sleep and went to exercise. Hearing Zhang Shaofei's voice, everyone was stunned, "Damn it, Thousand Miles of Sound!" Zhao Xin exclaimed, they had just reacted. Come on, Zhang Shaofei seemed to have spoken to them without using the communicator. "Ox Demon King, this should be what Ben Gufo said. Don't let the monsters in the demon world leave the Demonic Meeting Point alive today! Medicine Master, kill them!" With the tens of millions of troops brought by Medicine Master and Zi Zaitian, Ran Deng immediately felt confident that the alarm was lifted, and Zhang Shaofei headed into the cave. As I walked, I didn't know what was inside the cave, which was glowing with light. I took a general look around the cave, and found that the cave was quite large, and with the cover of the woods outside, it could be a secret base. The forest suddenly began to darken slowly, and finally became pitch black, but the giant sword in my hand became dark. It was getting brighter and brighter. "It's nothing, let's talk about educating children." Ji Mo pulled out a chair for her and let her sit firmly before he sat down. At this moment, the first golden wheel was approaching Jiang Wuye. He suddenly waved his arm, and at this moment, the powerful force gathered in his muscles was released with all his strength. The unicorn arm broke through the air and punched the sharp edge of the golden wheel.
